{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[President of the United States|United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that negotiations with [[Iran]] will be held in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], on April 20, with a [[United States|U.S.]] delegation led by [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]] and [[Ambassadors of the United States#Officeholders|special envoys]] [[Steve Witkoff]] and [[Jared Kushner]]. [https://aje.news/w7b54q?update=4504779 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/19/iran-says-talks-continue-while-it-retains-control-of-strait-of-hormuz-.html (CNBC)]
****[[Tasnim News Agency]] reports that Iran is undecided as to sending a negotiating delegation to Islamabad while a [[Naval blockade of Iran|naval blockade]] remains in place. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/iran-currently-has-no-decision-send-negotiating-delegation-pakistan-tasnim-2026-04-19/ (Reuters)]
***[[Naval blockade of Iran]]
****The [[United States Navy]] [[destroyer]] {{USS|Spruance|DDG-111|6}} and the [[31st Marine Expeditionary Unit]] stop and [[United States seizure of the Touska|seize]] control of the Iranian-flagged [[container ship]] ''[[Touska]]'', in the first direct action during the blockade. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-19/trump-says-us-seized-iranian-ship-blew-hole-in-its-engine-room?embedded-checkout=true (Bloomberg)] [https://taskandpurpose.com/news/marines-seize-cargo-ship-iran/ (''Task and Purpose'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] publishes a map of the territory that it claims to control in [[Lebanon]] for the first time. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-publishes-map-south-lebanon-territory-under-its-control-2026-04-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[New People's Army rebellion]]
**[[Toboso encounter]]
***Nineteen alleged [[New People's Army]] militants are killed in a [[shootout]] with [[Philippine Army|the army]] in [[Toboso, Negros Occidental|Toboso]], [[Negros Occidental]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/29f6e85233ba (TRT World)]
*[[Operation Southern Spear]], [[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
**Three people are killed in an [[United States Navy|American]] [[airstrike]] against a boat in the [[Caribbean Sea]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/19/us/politics/us-military-strike-boat-strike-caribbean.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and the [[March 23 Movement]] agree to facilitate [[humanitarian aid]] delivery and release prisoners within 10 days following talks in [[Montreux]], [[Switzerland]], and sign a [[memorandum]] establishing mechanisms to monitor a [[ceasefire]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContentP/2/566259/World/DR-Congo,-M-armed-group-agree-to-ease-aid,-free-pr.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]], [[Antisemitism in the United Kingdom]]
**A [[synagogue]] in [[North London]], [[England]], is targeted in a [[firebombing]] attack, which is suspected to be an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/synagogue-arson-attack-kenton-london-jewish-b2960520.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two civilians killed and three wounded in a [[mass shooting]] at a bar in [[San Luis Potosí (city)|San Luis Potosí]], [[San Luis Potosí]]. Authorities began to investigate the attack as part of a conflict between delictive cells. [https://sanluis.eluniversal.com.mx/seguridad/violento-ataque-en-bar-de-san-luis-potosi-deja-dos-muertos-y-tres-heridos/ (''El Universal'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
**Five gunmen are killed in a [[shootout]] with security forces in the municipality of [[General Terán, Nuevo León|General Terán]], [[Nuevo León]]. Authorities start a series surveillance operation in the area. [https://www.milenio.com/policia/enfrentamiento-deja-5-sospechosos-abatidos-en-general-teran-nuevo-leon (Milenio Noticias <small>in Spanish</small>)]
**Two Mexican officers and two [[Central Intelligence Agency]] agents are killed in a car crash in the northern Mexican state of [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]]. President [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] states her government is investigating "potential violations of national security", with their operation to reportedly destroy a  [[Clandestine operation|clandestine]] drug lab not pre-approved by the federal government. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mexico-us-officials-killed-car-crash-drug-lab-raid/ (CBS News)] [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-sheinbaum-chihuahua-us-officials-deaths-646664d05452ddbad7b39b9d480fd46e (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 25 people are killed and 13 others are injured in an explosion at a fireworks factory in [[Virudhunagar]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp867zy9j6ro (BBC News)]
*Eight people are killed, including two children, and three others are injured in two separate [[drowning]] incidents in the [[Kaveri]] river in [[Mysore district]], [[Karnataka]], India. [https://www.deccanherald.com/india/karnataka/mysuru/mysuru-eight-people-drown-in-cauvery-in-separate-incidents-3973817 (''Deccan Herald'')]
*Seven people are killed, including six children, in a [[propane tank]] explosion and fire at a house in [[Lamar Township, Pennsylvania|Lamar Township]], [[Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://www.wnep.com/article/news/local/clinton-county/fire-engulfs-home-after-propane-tank-explosion-home-collapse-long-run-road-lamar-clinton-county/523-177f1182-ad28-4e3b-a166-e168d48fdf5d (WNEP-TV)]
*A spectator is killed and two others are injured when a car crashes into spectators at the [[Codasur South American Rally Championship]] in [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]], [[Argentina]]. [https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2026/04/19/impactante-accidente-en-el-rally-sudamericano-un-auto-perdio-el-control-y-volco-contra-el-publico-en-cordoba/ (''Infobae'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*A fire destroys about 1,000 homes in a [[Stilt house|stilt settlement]] in [[Sandakan]], [[Sabah]], [[Malaysia]], displacing thousands of residents. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/fire-razes-1000-stilt-homes-in-malaysias-sabah-thousands-displaced-1.500511963 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Israel relations]]
**[[2026 state visit by Javier Milei to Israel]]
***[[Argentina|Argentine]] [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Javier Milei]] and [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] announce the launching of the [[Isaac Accords]] to foster cooperation between [[Israel]] and the [[Western Hemisphere]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/netanyahu-milei-launch-isaac-accords-to-foster-cooperation-between-israel-and-western-hemisphere/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Internet blackout in Iran]], [[Cyberwarfare during the 2026 Iran war]]
***Four people, including two foreign nationals, are arrested in [[Jolfa, Iran|Jolfa]], [[East Azerbaijan province]], Iran, on charges related to importing [[Starlink]] equipment and alleged intelligence activities involving networks linked to Israel and the U.S. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2026/04/1421455/iran-arrests-two-foreigners-over-starlink-device-imports (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
**[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
***[[King of Bahrain|King]] [[Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa]] of [[Bahrain]] announces that [[Bahraini nationality law]] will be reassessed so that actions can be taken against anyone who provided assistance to Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]], such as with espionage. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2640492/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[2026 Shreveport shooting]]
**Eight children are killed and two women are injured in a [[domestic violence]] [[Mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] in [[Shreveport, Louisiana|Shreveport]], [[Louisiana]], United States. The perpetrator later [[carjacking|carjacks]] a vehicle and flees across the [[Red River of the South|Red River]] to the adjacent [[Bossier City, Louisiana|Bossier City]], where he is fatally shot by [[Louisiana State Police|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/eight-children-killed-louisiana-mass-shooting-media-reports-say-2026-04-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Assistant United States Attorney|First U.S. attorney]] [[Bill Essayli]] announces that an Iranian woman has been arrested at the [[Los Angeles International Airport]] in [[California]] for allegedly helping Iran [[Arms trafficking|traffic weapons]] to [[Sudan]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/apr/19/woman-arrested-la-arms-trafficking-iran-africa (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Bulgarian parliamentary election]], [[2021–present Bulgarian political crisis|Bulgarian political crisis]]
**[[Bulgarians]] vote for 240 seats of the [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|National Assembly]] in the nation's eighth election since [[April 2021 Bulgarian parliamentary election|April 2021]]. Former [[President of Bulgaria|president]] [[Rumen Radev]] leads the [[soft eurosceptic]] [[Progressive Bulgaria]] coalition, the [[Front-runner|frontrunner]] of the election according to opinion polls. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260419-crisis-hit-bulgaria-votes-in-eighth-election-in-five-years (AFP via RFI)] [https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-election-radev-borissov-corruption-russia-427c265d8b314a00fbbcd159b76b52e2 (AP)]
*[[Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war]]
**Several universities across [[Islamabad]] and [[Rawalpindi]] in [[Pakistan]], including the [[International Islamic University]] and [[Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University]], will shift to online classes amidst a potential second round of [[Islamabad Talks|talks between Iran and the U.S.]] [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2603567/universities-in-twin-cities-go-online-ahead-of-expected-iranus-talks?amp=1 (''The Express Tribune'')]
*Nus Kei, chairperson of the [[Golkar Party]]'s [[Southeast Maluku Regency]] branch in [[Indonesia]], is assassinated at [[Karel Sadsuitubun Airport]]. The two perpetrators are subsequently arrested. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20260419180930-12-1349736/detik-detik-ketua-golkar-maluku-tenggara-nus-kei-tewas-ditikam (CNN Indonesia <small>in Indonesian</small>)] [https://www.tempo.co/politik/golkar-imbau-kader-tak-terpancing-kasus-penusukan-nus-kei-2130161 (''Tempo'' <small>in Indonesian</small>)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[AI boom]]
**[[Artificial intelligence industry in China]]
***A [[humanoid robot]] developed by [[China|Chinese]] company [[Honor (company)|Honor]] completes a [[half marathon]] in [[Beijing]] involving both robots and human runners in 50 minutes and 26 seconds, faster than [[Half marathon world record progression|the standing human world record]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/newslens/2026/0419/1569030-china-robots/ (AFP via RTÉ)] [https://www.foxnews.com/tech/chinese-robot-breaks-human-world-record-beijing-half-marathon (Fox News)]
*[[New Space Race]]
**American company [[Blue Origin]] successfully launches its [[New Glenn]] rocket using a [[Reusable launch vehicle|reused booster]], which it recovers after liftoff, but the communications satellite it carried for [[AST SpaceMobile]] is placed in an incorrect orbit. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260420-blue-origin-launches-rocket-with-used-booster-for-first-time (AFP via France 24)]
